blocks.text: Dono oviducts ek khokhle aur muscular organ mein khulti hain jise uterus kehte hain. Is ke teen hisse hain: fundus, body aur cervix. Fundus oviducts ke surakhon se oopar wala gol hissa hai. Body uterus ka sab se bara hissa hai. Uterus ke neeche wale tang hisse ko cervix kehte hain; cervix ka surakh vagina mein khulta hai.

Uterus ki deewar teen tehon (layers) se bani hai. Perimetrium sab se bahar wali patli teh hai. Myometrium beech wali moti teh hai jo smooth muscles se bani hai. Endometrium andar wali spongy teh hai; is ki do tehein hain: basal layer aur functional layer. Basal layer mein stem cells hote hain jo functional layer ko dobara banate hain. Functional layer menstrual cycle mein moti hoti hai aur phir jhar jati hai. Hamal (pregnancy) mein yeh mazeed moti ho jati hai taa ke embryo is mein jur (implant ho) sake. Is ki khoon wali jagahein (vascular spaces) mil kar aapas mein jur jati hain aur placenta banati hain, jo embryo aur foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deta hai.
